notes.title: Patch 19 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello witches,

Patch 19 is finally here! It not only brings important fixes, but also new features that we’re sure you’ll Enjoy. So without further ado, here are the patch notes:

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could prevent Patrice’s quest from continuing
[*] Fixed an issue that could prevent the completion of Long Wished Deliverance quest
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Cat to occasionally not speak with you during the Cat’s Quest
[*] “What about my apprenticeship” quest can now be completed
[*] Multiple UI fixes
[/list]

[h2]FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] As announced in the recent sneak peek, we are introducing quest markers! We would like to state yet again that we are against guiding players by hand and getting rid of the feeling of discovery. As such, we consider the current implementation to be a fair compromise. Of course, you are more than welcome to share your thoughts!
[*] Performance improvements. A new round of these should make the game play smoother. We improved performance and upscaling, Frame Generation will now work with every upscaler. TSR and FSR are recommended over DLSS, if possible. However, please do keep in mind minimum system requirements!
[*] Related to the above: Added a launcher that will let you select DX11 or DX12. The latter is recommended, but using the former could provide better results, depending on your config.

[b]!! IMPORTANT !! If you play on Steam Deck, ALWAYS select DX12![/b]

[*] Controller update. We have made changes and improvements to controls for players who prefer playing on a controller. Any feedback is appreciated!
[/list]

We hope these changes will improve your experience and make your stay on Fern Island more fun.


Best Regards,
Enjoy Studio team

notes.title: Patch 19 sneak peek!
notes.content:
Hello witches,

With Patch 19 coming soon to a Fern Island near you, we wanted to showcase its most important feature - quest markers. Our game was always supposed to provide an experience that rewards exploration and doesn’t babysit the player, letting them discover everything on their own. We do, however, realize that our approach to this might’ve been a little too hardcore, and as such, we will ease up a bit.

You received a quest, managed to get the required items, but don’t remember where the NPC was? Now you can simply consult your map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/14993a4568fc5cb9ff3a280c3e0db192c72a154e.png[/img]

Struggling to find a location where you can obtain quest items? Is the quest description not enough? Or are you trying to find a specific location? Open your map and look for yellow circles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/7c830d4164d591b642f2c245fe89763ad631f5cc.png[/img]

And if you don’t want to rely on the map so much, check your compass - when you’re close to a quest npc or objective, it will be marked!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/0adebf0bbc161af21defb4a457ed3693eba81b72.png[/img]

We hope that these changes will make the exploration of Fern Island even more fun!

Additionally, we have focused on texture optimization, so you can expect your game to perform better. Do still keep in mind minimum system requirements, though!

And finally expect plenty of bugfixes, mostly related to quests, both big and small ones!

Thanks for your support and see you on the Fern Island!



Best Regards,

Enjoy Studio S.A.

notes.title: Patch 18
notes.content:
Hello witches,

Today, we bring you another major patch, which includes important bugfixes and many fantastic improvements, that will surely make your stay on Fern Island more enjoyable. The patch notes are as follows:

[h2]BUGFIXES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Patrice quest can now be progressed correctly.
[*] “Protect the Flame” quest cutscene will now play correctly.
[*] Fixed dialogue with your cat next to an altar.
[*] Cuflows no longer change genders after adding them to a coop.
[*] Yellow Paffti no longer become invisible.
[*] Fixed bed edit prompt.
[*] Visual improvements for wild plants.
[*] Furniture is no longer misaligned when you place it.
[/list]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented optimization, mostly focused on textures. That way, the game will run smoother, and take less space on your drive! If you meet the game’s minimal requirements, but you still had performance issues, we encourage you to give the game another try.
[*] The days are now longer, and the sunset is delayed.
[*] You can now optionally activate an alternate interaction system in Options, which means you can interact with objects in front of you without relying on camera (makes it easier for controller users).
[*] Multiple fixes for the controller, mostly related to prompts and UI navigation.
[*] Implemented “change focus" option - if there are multiple objects in front of us, clicking "change focus" switches the interaction between the objects within range.
[*] After offering 10 favourite dishes in Paffti shrines, a Golden Paffti store will unlock, and sell random items.
[*] Re-balanced some in-game prices according to our internal testing and your feedback.
[*] You can now milk Tzoru! Simply purchase a Milker from Cassandra.
[*] You can now retrieve items from all chests in the crafting window (so you don't have to collect them manually). You can also exclude certain chests from this system if you want.
[*] Updated the system of adding essences to plants.
[*] Added message boards that will let you know which plants are available in a region, and in which season.
[*] You can now get higher quality gems from Rotottle.
[*] Implemented “selling day” - each saturday, the number of customers for your stall will increase.
[*] Added new furniture to the store.
[*] Added more Blueberry bushes.
[/list]

As always, your feedback is very welcome, and we encourage you to visit our Discord and chat with the devs!

Best Regards,

Enjoy Studio team

notes.title: Coming soon to a Fern Island near you!
notes.content:
Hello witches,

We have some news for you about an upcoming patch for The Witch of Fern Island. Here’s what you can expect for an update that’s coming earlier than you think:

Optimization. We realize that our game has rather high system requirements, and we’re doing our best to remedy that, at least a bit. As such, expect optimization changes that should make the game run more smoothly on less powerful machines, and most importantly - on Steam Deck! Still, remember that if your system specs go too much beyond what we consider the minimum, worse performance is unavoidable.
While we’re on the topic of optimization, please remember that there are some hurdles that are simply not passable. If you play on a laptop, always make sure that the game is using your actual graphics card, not the integrated one - this will make a massive difference.

Controller. There were some issues with controls, and I dare say we resolved them quite well. Expect greatly improved experience when using them after the patch!

Furniture. Simply put, you wanted more furniture, so we’re giving you more furniture. Just like that. We’re extremely nice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/ffff6adb3cdec064b4d0fc95cb9fa42524bd9d2e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/b659c5a44b2fb7d1fb73b1f2658077ab11004105.png[/img]

Not enough for you? In that case, you will soon be able to purchase even more optional, themed cosmetics - including a new, gorgeous set of clothes for Abrill!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/c722434019eefcf60bc8af8b3a22fc89f8381257.png[/img]

Some bug fixes are also coming. These are mostly related to quests and their progression.

We hope you Enjoy the update as much as we do.


Best Regards,

Enjoy Studio

notes.title: Patch 16
notes.content:
Hello witches,

Today, we’re pushing the first patch to the full version of The Witch of Fern Island. Thank you for all of the feedback so far, we’re working hard on resolving any issues you might have. Remember that the best way to voice both your concerns and encouragement is our Discord server. Come chat with us!

When it comes to issues with performance, remember that if you’re playing on a laptop, make sure that the game is not using your integrated graphics card when you launch it - this is a common issue on laptops and will greatly affect the performance. Additionally, this game uses DX12 by default, and some older configurations simply do not support it; to resolve this, please check out our pinned post on Steam Forums: 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1550010/discussions/0/4306075118780870912/

This is of course a temporary solution while we work on a more permanent one. We apologize for the inconvenience.

And now, time for the patch notes:

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller sticks can now be used during keyboard prompts that appear when you need to enter text (eg. naming your cat); previously, only d-pad was available
[*] Fixed an issue that could prevent the player from swapping tabs in menus with a controller
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause statue riddles to be impossible to complete
[*] Using a Nectar on Insect Hotel now correctly displays its duration
[*] Text prompt in Options that informs the player about having to restart the game to implement DX changes is now displayed correctly
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the game to become unresponsive while gifting items
[*] Fixed a commission with missing object and task giver information
[*] Fixed DLC items descriptions
[*] Fixed the effect description of Four Paws Amulet
[/list]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved controller navigation in stores and menus
[*] After starting a New Game, a new text prompt will be displayed, offering information about saving and profile systems used by the game
[*] Added “Controls” tab to Options on Steam Deck
[*] Added three new Vsync settings: FPS lock at 120, 144 and 240 (note that Frame Generation generates additional frames, so if you turn it ON, you might see the game go over the limit you set)
[*] Vsync is now “Off” by default
[*] Increased maximum flying altitude
[*] Increased lighting in the caves
[*] You can now pick up a Wardrobe
[/list]


Best Regards,
Enjoy Studio team

notes.title: The Witch of Fern Island Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Hello witches,

This is it! It's time! [b]The Witch of Fern Island will officially move out of Early Access and into 1.0 on 27th of February 2024![/b] Check out our RDA trailer!

[previewyoutube=F3TrnZ7bYHw;full][/previewyoutube]

Want more? Then join us as we bring you on an adventure through the Early Access!

[h1]New Areas[/h1]
The map has more than doubled in size since the EA release. New areas, such as the desert, swamps, and cliffs, are filled with content. There are new plants, puzzles, recipes, secrets, and location-related side quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/039c164b0150f50396a3fce7f799f4fe8fe52e6f.gif[/img]

Mysterious round portals are also open. After applying the appropriate potion, you can travel to Astra: an alternative, spiritual reality that overlays the entire world, effectively creating a second map of the same size.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/a9c3993f2ab3d59f320e96baacf7e11786ce2920.png[/img]

[h1]New Quests[/h1]
Another part of the game where you will find a vast amount of new content. Not all of them are locked behind character relationships, though for those who enjoy building connections, there are quest lines for Yutu, Charna, and Patrice. We mentioned location-related tasks earlier: searching for plants and gaining knowledge about them. In addition to those, with the introduction of the camera mechanic and taking pictures, two more interesting stories have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/d923d71089468030e7b5b024d4f585a164afab3b.png[/img]

However, the largest of the stories is the Main Quest, consisting of many significant tasks in which we uncover elaborate narratives, explore new places, and accomplish great feats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/14eb0a85850ae8f30a897d62117dcf8b01abefba.gif[/img]

[h1]New Activities[/h1]
The town is no longer as deserted as it was back in May. Now, tourists are everywhere, and twice a year, festivals with unique attractions are organized. And if you're looking for more intimate gatherings, the game has introduced five hangouts with selected characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/cd012a1b261bb741f92a7a6075e915d14ac87198.gif[/img]

New possibilities have also opened up in terms of item crafting. Now, among the crafting stations, you will find quern, clothing sewing machines, animal feed mixers, ovens, and, if unlocked, mills as well.

What else is important among the new things? There are more possibilities to upgrade tools, the altar, and the house. In addition to cuflows, you can now also breed Tzoru. On the island, you can now catch insects using a net and attract them with nectar.

And remember the museum with empty display cases? Now you can fill them. ALL of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/5ece30e6137436760aeea868ac9fdff5c12a4f90.gif[/img]

[h1]New Improvements[/h1]
Further changes suggested by the community over the last few months, as well as those we undertook on our own initiative, focused on improving existing systems.

Quick tool selection: From now on, key items such as the key or camera are always accessible to the player under a dedicated button.
The number of available map stickers has increased so much that a new sorting mechanism was needed.
Does anyone else remember how we used to have to use the gift-giving mechanic to hand over items during a quest? That's no longer the case.
What we do have now are profiles. From now on, you are no longer limited to a single save file.

We've also increased the number of gifts liked and disliked by characters. Now, hitting the right item among the hundreds already existing in the game is not unreasonably difficult. We've also taken care of price balance to ensure that every craft is appropriately rewarding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/d6fa9e6b7dfd64ccaa029b1472b18d4bc2896f8e.gif[/img]

[h1]Quality of life Features[/h1]
Since the Early Access release, there have been many valuable opinions regarding the most problematic mechanics in the game. Throughout the entire development process, we carefully listened to the community feedback and endeavored to implement key changes as quickly as possible. Here are a few more notable changes compiled with previously reported inconveniences.

[list]
[*] The lack of space for items in chests was a challenge for players in the early versions. However, an additional recipe for a large chest quickly appeared, and later, a special rack where these chests can be placed more densely. Expanding the game with new locations and quests significantly increased the number of available space-expanding stones for equipment. Additional space has also been added to some furniture and crafting stations.
[*] We also increased the max size of the item stack to 100 and enabled selling multiple items on stall. Both of these have often been requested.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/e9317e9b6c6d33a7a5d639710cdff802944c2878.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] We've read a lot in your reviews and comments about the targeting issue; the interaction system plays a crucial role in the game and needed improvement. The multitude of changes, new content, and other priorities meant that we had to wait until now to address this aspect of the game. We're proud to say that from now on, hitting targets will be easier.
[*] For everyone who needed more information, we've been working to continuously fill in any gaps in the compendium and descriptions to make them more direct. An example of this are seeds, which now always specify the season in which they grow and how long their growth takes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/790455247ab2737409389cac658370cde8a0b9d5.gif[/img]

[h1]Abstract[/h1]
Something that was initially intended to be a modest summary has grown into an incredibly lengthy announcement text. So many changes and novelties! The effects of our work listed here are just the most important ones we wanted to highlight. Those who have been following closely know how many smaller changes were introduced in each patch and how many bugs were fixed.

We promise to continue to listen carefully to your feedback and make any necessary changes and improvements. We hope that this summary will encourage all those who had doubts in the initial phase of the project to return. And if you're new here, we hope it convinces you to believe in our game.

Best Regards,

Enjoy Studio Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/1efcda4fd550cadb77a26268757869f459f8ef52.png[/img]

notes.title: The time has come to unravel the truth
notes.content:
[h2]The signs were everywhere[/h2]
The kaoh sites. Metal barriers. Fire barriers. Area in Astra. Some of these places were locked for very long, some got opened already. Now, there are no more secrets. Get there, look for all the clues and then the story will unravel. Where to start? Siemibor will talk to you shortly after you finish Soul of Boran quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/ce124b1a7d4dada5f7650553bf5aa633d6bd2eaa.gif[/img]

[h2]Know your predecessors[/h2]
Main quest revolves around the story of the previous witches. Dhalia lived before you, while Asparatha dates back to ancient times and became somewhat of a mythological character. Part of Rosha’s story is already told in that one note you already might possess. There will be time for the rest of them. Omari lives long enough to remember yet another witch…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/14eb0a85850ae8f30a897d62117dcf8b01abefba.gif[/img]

[h2]Decide your fate[/h2]
Will you obey? Will you complete the task bestowed upon you by the guardians? The answer is not so obvious! You might learn something that they don't want you to know... better check all notes you find! In the end, you will have to choose, and it's best if you are aware what that choice entails.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/a662a6285c3cbe43d24c294a5decec64d2fcb68c.gif[/img]

[h2]The whole island is now revealed[/h2]
Main quest gives you access to volcano, kaoh sites, sunken town, the ancient maze… and what's more, the rest of the island is available too! What's hidden behind these large hills? Let’s find out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/039c164b0150f50396a3fce7f799f4fe8fe52e6f.gif[/img]

Seven new quests and new area to explore! That’s what we can call a great update. Now you know what we were doing behind the scenes when previous updates didn’t involve new quests. This one definitely does!

notes.content:
Hey witches,

Coming soon to Fern Island near you, a fresh batch of new, amazing content! Wondering how you'll be able to celebrate?

[h1]With festivals![/h1]
It is time to introduce the first two annual festivals, during which townspeople cultivate their traditions and commemorate various magical creatures living among them on the island. During paffti festival, wood and stone figurines will be hidden somewhere in the town. Meanwhile, for the Nili festival, it’s a good idea to carry some acorns or any other small, throwable objects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/81a7490ed214ac066c2edce8321f56376c9738d8.gif[/img]

[h1]And hangouts![/h1]
Want to know more about townspeople? Now you can spend time with them! Five new hangout events contribute new recipes, including the long-awaited one. Time to talk about flowers, admire growing mushrooms, learn history or attend rehearsal of that one band we all wanted to hear from!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/cd012a1b261bb741f92a7a6075e915d14ac87198.gif[/img]

New update introduces tailoring! First bunch of clothes that are craftable and dyeable! Ready to cosplay as Miruta? Who says a witch cannot be the mayor?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/e5763323ecc8b893af2da9b51d700da7c7093f68.gif[/img]

[h1]And… insects!?[/h1]
A new hotel on the island? Dozens of new hotels on the island!? How? Who built them, when? Oh! These are insect hotels. Starting from these updates, you can find places on the island where you can catch all sorts of butterflies, beetles, praying mantises and grasshoppers! Grab a bugnet (the better one!) and go hunting.
Anton doesn’t like it, but Patrice definitely does.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/375632255c01bf6b46a042ff9bf8e3233197c689.gif[/img]

[h1]And memories![/h1]
This is the day of the museum's grand opening! From now on, you can donate bones, crystals and artifacts to the exhibit. Urushu will gladly accept your generosity and repay you with unique rewards, among which the most important one is… the new unique outfit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/5ece30e6137436760aeea868ac9fdff5c12a4f90.gif[/img]

New exciting stuff is coming, but that’s not all! It’s just the preparations for something even bigger, which will come with future updates. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Fern Island Travel Agency will soon open!
notes.content:
Hello witches,
Today, we want to tease the upcoming big update. Summer is upon us, and that means the holiday season is too! notes.title: April Dev Update
notes.content:
[h2]A witch is a profession[/h2]
[h3]Let’s meet with the locals[/h3]
Being a witch means being close to people. They are the ones who buy your wares and ask for help. In addition to regular sales at the stall, you will also take care of more individual needs. Acquaintances, however, are not just to increase your income, but simply to establish sincere bonds of friendship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/8c78b623a0562f3e705a03142de0551e2c64c4fd.png[/img]

[h3]Cultural Exchange[/h3]
Fern Island is a mixture of different cultures, each with their own traditions and customs. Engaging with them builds deeper relationships and understanding with people. Symbolism is as important as magic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/7d395f957fd8b2398d00a69282faaaa67e24941a.png[/img]

[h3]Crafting Magic[/h3]
Quests often involve creating a specific potion or talisman specifically for a person's needs. You know best what needs to be prepared! That is... if you find the notebook pages that got lost around the island beforehand!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/675fe4fbb18bf93f73247925090f1ab5d3a1224e.png[/img]

[h3]A mystery[/h3]
Quests may seem ordinary at first, but these are just appearances! They often have a deeper personal meaning or hide magic that no one knew about or, on the contrary, didn't want to tell. Your task is to get to the truth, regardless of the danger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/90f568790018943aab1f966d38ec31ea1251c26d.png[/img]

We create quests with passion, we try to make the choices made in them meaningful and create individual versions of the stories told. We hope you enjoy exploring them!

Best Regards,

Enjoy Studio Team

notes.title: March Dev Update + Release Date Update
notes.content:
[h2]Time for some magic![/h2]
A witch is a witch, isn't she? It's about time to talk about magical rituals that you can perform at the stone altar outdoors, or your personal one at home. So get to it! What is needed? Let me explain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/a53a44bcd7cb27a48cf89f5d8db36a788ee0f029.jpg[/img]

[h2]Prepare necessary resources[/h2]
Every self-respecting witch stocks ingredients for her potions. For rituals, you need them too: usually related to what you want to achieve. As a certain potion master used to say: "Understanding what the ingredients do will help you understand how the entire thing works". Thus, for example, in the composition of the Ritual of Fortune Telling you need cornflowers, which are the basis of all kinds of divinations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/2c0c5d3214bc7fd8976fe5d032cb8339bda5d1df.png[/img]

[h2]It has been done! [/h2]
So what's next? Usually, we wait. Rituals that increase the quality of plants, change them or summon the weather take effect only the next day. And you can do a lot with them. Just look at what vegetables look like when we turn them into a magical version with a ritual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/2f5467e1e7d1528723a4717cfbbf212503712273.gif[/img]

[h2]Make your life more magical[/h2]
With the help of rituals you can protect your farm from pests, increase your strength, strengthen your tools. The rarer ones will allow you to enchant a broom or a crystal ball. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/48e19ca2ce468d7ccbc2b9b45ddfebeeb5e406a8.gif[/img]

There are already quite a few rituals in the game, and we plan to add even more over time.

We also have information about the release date of Early Access for you. We were originally aiming at Q1 2023, but after careful deliberation we’ve decided to move it to Q2 2023. This is because we need a little more time for the game to be the best it can be. Above all else, this extra time will allow us to iron out some important bugs and make your gameplay experience better!

Stay tuned and see you again in the next update!

Best Regards,

Enjoy Studio Team

notes.title: February Dev Update
notes.content:
[h1][h2][h1]Who lives on the farm?[/h1][/h2][/h1]

Meet the cuflows, fancy magical creatures to raise on your farm. These cunning little fellows are ideal for a witch’s farm. We feed them, we give them shelter and build a relationship. Remember to give them enough of their favourite food!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/1d869083f6cbc8b69182c3ada262c163159922e7.png[/img]

[h1]Special Structures[/h1]

Your cuflows live in the Cuflow Coop. You can build it anywhere on the farm, and make it a part of the overall design. As you progress you can expand it, or build a second one. A Breeding Shack is also something to keep nearby!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/f8ce751e02b0812c9592514fff0309bb51cd92f8.gif[/img]
[h1]
This one is red, this one is blue[/h1]

There are lots of different races of cuflows. Some live in the wilds, where you can catch them. Others are owned by various people - finish a quest to get a unique one for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/7fb1f0b062dc309ef21bfae7531f6b7e80f1350d.png[/img]

[h1]Breed your cuflows![/h1]

Take two, put them together, get an egg the next day ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°). A new cuflow will be born! With the right choice, you might obtain a totally new race, unseen anywhere before! It might be the only way to collect certain rare colored feathers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42843316/74cb0179bc2b1488694440a827c8e2a863a3bccc.png[/img]

We plan to give special traits to all of the obtainable races. Try to get all of them in your Cuflow Coop! See you next time in the next update!

Best Regards,

Enjoy Studio Team
